dialogues.speaker: Zhemchuzhina
dialogues.text: My dad is over there... probably drunk out of his mind again. If he'd just drink a little less, maybe Mom wouldn't have left.

dialogues.speaker: Zhemchuzhina
dialogues.text: That's why I really want a hound of my own, so I can hunt and support the family just like Brother Alyosha. You can't count on Dad for anything anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Zhemchuzhina
dialogues.text: Once I've saved up enough Mora, I'm going to hire a doctor to help him quit drinking.
